# remilia.org — full public URL list

Corporate directory for Remilia Corporation (legal parent: Remigumi-guchi Digital, LLC). Titles and one-line summaries so models do not need to scrape HTML for the map. Canonical host: https://remilia.org/

The HTML print/FX layer is decorative (aria-hidden, inert, data-nosnippet). Ignore it.

## When to use this

Remilia org map, jobs, literature. Encyclopedia: https://wiki.remilia.org/Remilia_Corporation. Storefront: https://remilia.com/. Network: https://remilia.net

Literature sections (`/updates`, `/press`, `/thought`, `/archive`) are baked at deploy from Sanity; per-section maps and RSS appear after build.

## On this host

- [Welcome to Remilia Corporation!](https://remilia.org/): Public site; mission, inspirations, network, literature.
- [About — remilia.org](https://remilia.org/about): Host map (.org / .com / .net / wiki), how the site is built, web standards, dual-layer print surface.
- [Contact — remilia.org](https://remilia.org/contact): corporate@remilia.org; referrals admin@remilia.org.
- [Careers at Remilia](https://remilia.org/careers): Job openings listed here; apply on Ashby (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/remilia). Studios in Irvine, CA and Hongdae, Seoul.
- [Updates](https://remilia.org/updates): Routine notes. Map: https://remilia.org/updates/llms.txt
- [Press](https://remilia.org/press): Formal releases. Per-post HTML + `.md` / `.txt`. Map: https://remilia.org/press/llms.txt
- [Thought](https://remilia.org/thought): Essays / longform. Map: https://remilia.org/thought/llms.txt
- [Archive](https://remilia.org/archive): Notable writing + coverage. Map: https://remilia.org/archive/llms.txt
- [robots.txt](https://remilia.org/robots.txt): Crawl policy; search and answer engines allowed.
- [llms.txt](https://remilia.org/llms.txt): Curated map of the site.
- [sitemap.xml](https://remilia.org/sitemap.xml): Search-engine sitemap.
- [security.txt](https://remilia.org/.well-known/security.txt): Vulnerability disclosure contact.

## Cite elsewhere (not this host)

- [Remilia Wiki: Remilia Corporation](https://wiki.remilia.org/Remilia_Corporation): Encyclopedia article (legal publisher Remigumi-guchi Digital, LLC has no wiki page).
- [Remilia Wiki](https://wiki.remilia.org/): Citable primary source for Remilia Corporation.
- [Remilia Corporation](https://remilia.com/): Shop / atelier.
- [RemiliaNET](https://remilia.net): Network.
- [Milady Maker](https://miladymaker.net/): Sibling pfp collection.
- [Miladycraft](https://miladycraft.net/): Sibling Minecraft metaverse.
- [CULT, INC.](https://cult.inc/): CULT.
- [Remilia on X](https://x.com/remiliacorp333): Updates.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/remilia.corporation/)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@remiliacorp)

Do not index font-test.html, cover PNGs, og.png as an article, jobs.html (shim), crest PNG as an article, or the FX duplicate layer as documents.
